name: @w6w-apps/dust
description: List agents, run conversations, and search knowledge on Dust — the AI agent platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Dust is a workspace platform for building and running AI agents on your company's own knowledge and tools. This app covers the agent/conversation surface a workflow needs: list, get and search agent configurations; create a conversation with an initial message (optionally mentioning an agent, and optionally waiting for its first answer); post follow-up messages into an existing conversation; cancel an in-progress generation; and attach inline text to a conversation as a content fragment for extra context.

It also covers read access to the workspace's spaces (projects) and data sources, including semantic search over one data source's documents — the same retrieval an agent's own Search tool uses, callable directly from a workflow.

A Dust workspace lives in exactly one of two regions (US or EU), each with its own API host and its own key — this app's connection form collects that alongside the API key and workspace id, and its health check separates a genuine outage from a region mismatch, which otherwise look identical.
